title: Kiritani Haruka — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A Certain Place on a Certain Day and Time

<Ah, it's on.
Should be recording.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Thank you, Shii—I mean... S.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Ah, I think I know who it is now.>
<Nope, I didn't hear anything. What are you talking about?>
<Shizuku's so adorable lol.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Thank you for coming as well, H.>

rows.Speaker: H
rows.Line: <Of course. It's for Kiritani's birthday after all, so I'm happy to be here.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Hehe, I'm glad.
Well then, let's start.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <To everyone watching Haruka's special birthday livestream, hello. I'm Shizuku Hinomori.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I'll be asking Haruka's schoolmates, S and H, about what Haruka would like as a gift.>

rows.Speaker: S & H
rows.Line: <Thank you for having us.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Neither of you have been in the same class as Haruka, but you've still been getting closer to her, right?>

rows.Speaker: H
rows.Line: <Yes. Our childhood friends were in the same class as Kiritani before, so that's part of how we got to know each other.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Becoming friends with your friends' friend and getting more connected that way is so wonderful.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Well then, without further ado, is there anything you think Haruka would like as a gift?>

rows.Speaker: S
rows.Line:
<That's a good question...
So to clarify, you don't know what the other teams chose?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Correct. We agreed to keep it a secret until we finished recording.>

rows.Speaker: S
rows.Line:
<Gotcha...
It might overlap with the others, but you probably won't go wrong with “that”.>

rows.Speaker: H
rows.Line: <I think so too. I can only come up with “that” when I think of Kiritani.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <What's “that”?>

rows.Speaker: H & S
rows.Line: <Phenny.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Oh! That's right!
Haruka loves Phenny.>

rows.Speaker: H
rows.Line: <I think new Phenny merch went on sale recently as well. Right, S?>

rows.Speaker: S
rows.Line: <You mean the one you can dress up? I thought it'd mainly be for kids, but it was pretty high quality.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Oh, really? That sounds like it would be a great gift.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I know! What if I gift her the new Phenny and make original costumes to go with it?>

rows.Speaker: H
rows.Line: <Wow, that sounds fun! I'm good at sewing, so I'd love to help.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Thank you! If you don't mind, I'd really appreciate it.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And so, my gift is the dress-up Phenny plushie and an original costume.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I did the design while S checked the cuteness and H helped with sewing the costume.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
They didn't only agree to the interview, but helped out with making the gift as well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I know how busy Mochizuki and Hinomori are with their band, and yet...
That makes me so happy.)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Original costume?! That's awesome!>
<She did design their costumes before.>
<Having someone who can sew makes a big difference!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There are a lot of comments about this gift you each had an important part in.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! And now you've seen all of our gifts!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So to reiterate, Minori has gone with running shoes and a pack of shoelaces.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I have decided on a ticket to an all-you-can-eat sweets buffet with a special chef.
And Shizuku has gone with a Phenny plushie and an original costume.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you so much for preparing such lovely gifts.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was a really tough decision. I didn't know who prepared each gift, but I chose the one thing I wanted the most out of all of them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright then, shall we get Haruka to reveal her answer in the envelope?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please do the honors, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, here I go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The gift I chose... The one I wanted the most is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku's Phenny plushie and original costume!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Ooh! She went with Phenny!>
<Congrats, Shizuku!>
<For real?! I totally thought sweets!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you for picking my gift, Haruka!
I'm so glad I made it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you for this wonderful gift.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I should've known it'd be Phenny!
That was an idea, but I was sure there'd be overlap so I decided against it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same here.
I thought I was on the right track with sweets to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I really did have a very hard time choosing one gift though.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori's running shoes are very practical and Airi's all-you-can-eat sweets even come with a chef.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was only able to finally make a decision this morning, so please don't feel bad.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't know you spent that long thinking about it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, I don't have any regrets!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That means it was a super close match!>
<You put up a good fight, Minori, Airi!>
<So what happens to the other gifts?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, regardless of whether she selected them or not, we'll still be giving our gifts to Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, first and foremost, let's have Shizuku present her gift. The winner of this segment!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Haruka!
I hope you have fun dressing Phenny up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Of course, I'm going to cherish him.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So... This is the plushie and the costume that already came with it, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And this is the original... Ah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh my gosh...
You made this costume look exactly like mine!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We were only able to make one, but I'm happy with how cute it looks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's so cute! I can't wait to dress him up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm going to come up with the cutest outfit for you, Phenny.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Squeal*

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Th-That was so cute...>
<I've never seen Haruka smile like this before!>
<Thank you Shizuku. Thank you Phenny.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright then, let's finish the stream off by wishing Haruka a happy birthday once again!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, Airi, Shizuku. And everyone who came to watch our stream, thank you so much for all of the birthday wishes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm going to keep working hard as an idol, so I'm counting on your support!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haruka, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We watched your stream. I didn't realize those videos were what Minori meant by recording. I wasn't able to help out since I had work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was a little nervous about appearing in the stream, but I'm glad it worked out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be honest, I didn't expect her to be on cloud nine after receiving that gift. It was definitely worth putting our heads together to think about the costume.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Agreed. I hope you have a fun time dressing Phenny up, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Haruka! Shoes and shoelaces were a pretty smart idea for a gift, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The shoelace pack has a bunch of different options, so I hope you have fun switching between the different designs.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Before I forget! I wanna hear about the behind-the-scenes stuff, like what you thought of the gifts and who you thought prepared which gift, so let's catch up sometime!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Haruka♪
Happy birthday, Haruka☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The gift showdown was super fun!
I couldn't help but be like “Oh, I see, I see” when you went through each gift!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
I'm so glad they made you smile a whole lot!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the way, Airi says we can join you for her all-you-can-eat sweets!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, really?! Then let's all go together on a day when you can eat sweets, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds like a plan♪
I'll send you a message later. I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We already said this in the stream, but the gifts that didn't win are still for you, so please use them to your heart's content!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Y'know, I was a little worried about Haruka's IRL friends making an appearance in the stream, but it seemed like most of our viewers were interested in knowing more about them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. It was wonderful to see all those kind comments.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We better make sure to thank everyone who helped us again!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yup!
But first, today's all about celebrating Haruka's birthday to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, then let's head back to Haruka with the cake.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for all of the birthday wishes, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've been getting more opportunities to appear on TV and more chances to meet you all too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But this is just the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm going to keep putting in more and more effort so we can deliver more performances and meet more of you going forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I'll be looking forward to your continued support.
